title: Integrate approved Emberfall layered Android UI baseline v0.4
outcome: Rebuild the exact approved 10-screen EMBERFALL visual master as separate, data-driven Android UI components and graphic layers, preserving source class/world identities.
scope: Inspect the actual game Android app repository and current GameState/content architecture before copying files.
Import EMBERFALL_ANDROID_GRAPHICS_v0.4.zip and merge its Android resources.
Implement all ten screens as native, interactive Android UI using the SVG masters as layout references and graphic layers as reusable visual sources.
Preserve Ashen Monk (Ember/Moss), Quarry Witch (Tide/Violet), The Unlit (Gold/Ash) in that order; Ashen Monk must remain first.
Use painterly The Unlit image and archive prior vector fallback.
Implement Combat from actual GameState: 49 visible cells, two engine-provided intents, live Ink/Run/Wall/Vigil/Block/Flasks and real cards.
Bind all numbers and rules text to content/state; no game rules in the UI module.
Run actual Gradle/GateRunner checks and device screenshot/accessibility/performance checks.
exclusions: Do not introduce replacement classes or make Shade playable.
Do not use the master poster as a full-screen runtime bitmap.
Do not use generated mockup text or values as game-rule authority.
Do not claim Android build/device acceptance until those checks run in the real app repo.
acceptance: All ten screens are implemented as native, data-driven UI using separate visual layers.
Class Select shows Ashen Monk, Quarry Witch, The Unlit in original order with correct hue pairs.
Shade remains a prior-deck encounter; Act I boss remains The Hollow Warden.
Combat renders a live 7x7 board, two engine-generated intents and a live card hand.
Master-art hierarchy, palette, material and screen composition are reviewed against the exact source hash.
Screenshots at 360x800, 390x844 and 412x915 are reviewed; accessibility and touch targets pass.
Gradle build/lint/tests and physical-device performance evidence pass.
Independent Mastery review is recorded against the exact app candidate SHA.
evidence_required: app baseline SHA and candidate SHA
changed paths and asset manifest diff
Gradle GateRunner logs with exit code and log hash
independent Mastery review against exact candidate_ref
